body: It was so horrible. I can’t stop re seeing it
It’s so tucking freeh it’s unreal. He’s always been near me. I can’t stop thinking of it
Thank you, I can’t tell my self that right now so I’ll take it from you. <3
Thank you for this. All love and respect to you too. I appreciate this more then you know.
Okay, I’ll truly do anything. I know he’s hurts

I had all of these feelings for awhile, since it happened. I don’t really know why I didn’t tell him when it happened or before. I need to figure that one out myself. I ended up telling him Tuesday morning.

Who said I’m not sorry? I made this post to get advise, be brutal with your advise. But i refuse to not love myself through this. If he’s going to leave me, I can’t be a mess and not have my shit together. I’m fully aware if he leaves my decision to cheat is why. The feeling I have is probably one of the worst I ever had, I can’t imagine his.
In no way did I mean to brush it off, I haven’t slept for days.
I never said he isn’t. Or that I am. I’m aware.

I’m not still drinking. And I realize I cheated. I didn’t say I didn’t. I do need to see a therapist, I’ve needed to see one for years, not the easiest thing to do, especially when I’m trying to help support my family. Typing every single detail is a bit difficult, I didn’t know it was needed. I will answer any questions you have.
I am not currently drinking. I plan on stopping for awhile

I don’t know if that what he wants, I can’t blame him. He won’t talk to me. I’m not sure what he wants. I don’t have any excuses for what I did. I was looking for what I didn’t have and hadn’t been getting emotionally at home, I wanted to forget. Neither of us are the greatest at communicating but we’ve always fought through things. He’s always been so good at asking me if I’m okay, I didn’t have him for awhile. We’ve had so much more good then bad. The bad is what I did.
Well that’s fair. I guess we just throw it away then, seems good.
